productFit.name: Warrior Tripods The Commander
productFit.reason: Warrior sells from its US shop with US prices; I found no European dealer or EU retailer listing. Neutral note: mainly sold in the US.

productFit.name: BOG DeathGrip Infinite Carbon Fiber Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: all4shooters measured (not maker): 2925 g, 78 cm packed, clamp about 150 cm high at 20 deg; counterweight hook max. 11,4 kg (25 lb); tube diameters about 35,4/31,8/28,2 mm

localFacts.fact: Ley 42/2007 (Annex VII) lists among prohibited methods artificial light sources, devices to light targets and sight devices with an image converter or electronic image amplifier for night shooting.

Each autonomous community regulates night waits; an authorization for an espera nocturna al jabali does not automatically allow a thermal or night scope, the permit must name the device (cazapop summary of the rules, informative only).
all4shooters measured the BOG DeathGrip Infinite CF at 2925 g and 78 cm packed, clamp about 150 cm high at full extension; sold in the EU by STROBL.CZ.
A German seller lists the Vortex Radian Carbon ball head kit at 25 kg max. load (leveling head kit 20 kg).
Local terms: tripode de tiro / tripode de caza, rotula, cabezal nivelador, carril Arca-Swiss, espera, aguardo, puesto.

localPainPoints.pain: Spanish espera hunters say the rifle rest on top of a cheap tripod wobbles and tips the rifle forward or back under the weight of the rifle and scope.
localPainPoints.fix: A ball head or leveling base under an Arca clamp, rifle balanced before the wait (English post fix for tilt and wiggle).

quotes.text: le veo poca estabilidad y por el peso del rifle y el visor tiende a moverse si no está perfectamente equilibrado

localPainPoints.pain: Hunters set up the tripod and then still shoot off-hand out of habit.
localPainPoints.fix: Practice off the tripod before the season and swing through the shooting lanes once before the wait.

quotes.text: me pasa una pieza y la sigo tirando a pulso, ni me acuerdo del trípode

localPainPoints.pain: Every gram counts when the tripod is carried a lot.
localPainPoints.fix: Carbon (Fatboy 2,7 kg, BOG 2,9 kg) if you walk; the 2,5 kg aluminium SLIK when the car is close.

quotes.text: cualquier gramo que te quites de pes, parece que no pero es fundamental

localGain.point: Legal context for night waits in Spain: Ley 42/2007 bans night-shooting sight devices as a method; regional permits must name the device.
Answers the Spanish espera complaints (wobbly rest, tilt, habit of shooting off-hand) with the matching fix.
European measurements of the BOG (2925 g, 78 cm packed) and the 25 kg EU figure for the Vortex ball head kit.
Which picks are hard to get in Europe (Fatboy, Warrior) and which are sold here (Vortex, BOG).
